comments.note: Added actions(): GridActions to DataGridInterface allowed removing the instanceof DataGrid guard from BaseGridRenderer::getColspan() and renderHeaderCells(). The DataGrid import in BaseGridRenderer was removed as no longer needed.

DataGrid::generateOutput() uses isset($this->actions) to guard the renderActionsRow() call, but uses $this->actions !== null to guard processSubmittedActions(). These are functionally equivalent for nullable properties but inconsistent style. Consider unifying to the null-check pattern.

Example file 3-grid-actions.php uses the existing renderer()->selectBootstrap5() API rather than the non-existent setRenderer()/createBootstrap5Renderer() API described in the WP spec. The existing fluent API is correct.

summary: QA FAIL — critical bug in examples/3-grid-actions.php (stale code appended) violates AC3. 2 additional medium/low findings detailed below.

comments.note: CRITICAL — examples/3-grid-actions.php: stale code from an older example was accidentally appended after the valid closing </html> at line 74. Lines 75-149 output raw PHP code as literal text into the HTTP response. Line 150 contains '<?php echo $grid; ?>' which PHP re-enters and executes, causing the grid to be rendered a SECOND time in the response. The valid file should end at line 74. Fix: delete lines 75-153 from the file.

BaseGridRenderer::getColspan() (line 364) and renderHeaderCells() (line 251) both call $this->grid->actions() which lazily creates a GridActions instance in DataGrid even when the user configured no actions. As a consequence, isset($this->actions) in DataGrid::generateOutput() evaluates to true for every grid (set by the renderer before that check is reached), making the guard meaningless. Safe only because renderActionsRow() returns '' when no actions are registered. Recommend adding a hasActions(): bool method to DataGridInterface that checks the property without lazy-creating it, and using that for the isset guard in generateOutput().

DataGrid::generateOutput() uses isset($this->actions) on line 97 and $this->actions !== null on line 71 for the same nullable ?GridActions property — inconsistent null-check style. Noted by Developer in implementation, still present.

summary: Rework: removed stale legacy code that was appended after the closing </html> of examples/3-grid-actions.php. File now ends at the </html> tag (74 lines). PHPStan: zero errors on the fixed file.

comments.note: Rework: deleted stale legacy code (lines 75-153) that was accidentally retained after the initial replace_string_in_file. The replace operation only replaced the opening PHP block, leaving the body of the old file appended. Fixed by a targeted replace that removes everything after the closing </html>.

The QA medium finding re hasActions() / lazy-init is noted. Per scope constraints, adding hasActions() to DataGridInterface is deferred — it is outside WP-003 scope and would require modifications to BaseGridRenderer and DataGrid beyond this WP. Recorded as a future improvement.

summary: QA PASS — all 8 acceptance criteria verified. High-severity bug from previous QA cycle (stale code after closing </html>) is confirmed resolved: examples/3-grid-actions.php ends cleanly at 74 lines with zero PHPStan errors. AC1 (processSubmittedActions before output) verified at DataGrid.php lines 71–73. AC2 (actions(): GridActions on DataGridInterface) confirmed. AC3 (no PHP errors in example) confirmed. AC4 (callback invocation with selected IDs) verified in GridActions::processSubmittedActions(). AC5 (select-all checkbox) verified in BaseGridRenderer::createSelectionHeaderCell() onclick handler. AC6 (placeholder + actions in dropdown) verified in renderActionsRow(). AC7 (separator as visual divider) verified as <option class='separator'>. AC8 (PHPStan level 6) confirmed 0 errors on all WP-003 files. Two pre-existing/out-of-scope observations noted below but no blockers.

comments.note: DataGrid::generateOutput() uses two different null-check styles for the same nullable ?GridActions property: `$this->actions !== null` on line 71 (processSubmittedActions guard) and `isset($this->actions)` on line 97 (renderActionsRow guard). Functionally identical but inconsistent. Should be unified to a single style. Pre-existing convention issue, not a blocker.

BaseGridRenderer::getColspan() (line 364) and renderHeaderCells() (line 251) both call $this->grid->actions() which lazy-creates a GridActions instance in DataGrid even when the user configured no actions. The guard `hasActions()` prevents incorrect behavior, but the lazy-init means isset($this->actions) in DataGrid::generateOutput() is always true after rendering. A future hasActions(): bool on DataGridInterface (reading the property without creating it) would eliminate the side-effect. Deferred — out of WP-003 scope.

summary: Code review PASS. All 8 acceptance criteria verified independently via code inspection and confirmed by the passing QA cycle. PHPStan reports 0 errors on the 4 WP-003 files (DataGrid.php, DataGridInterface.php, BaseGridRenderer.php, examples/3-grid-actions.php); the 14 project-wide errors are all pre-existing stubs. The example file ends cleanly at 74 lines with no stale code. Four low/medium observations recorded below — none are blockers for this WP.

comments.note: DataGrid::generateOutput() uses two different null-check idioms for the same ?GridActions property: `$this->actions !== null` (line 71, processSubmittedActions guard) and `isset($this->actions)` (line 97, renderActionsRow guard). Both are functionally equivalent for a nullable typed property but the inconsistency increases cognitive noise. Recommend unifying to `$this->actions !== null` throughout.

GridActions::__construct() accepts DataGrid (concrete class) rather than DataGridInterface. This breaks the interface-driven architecture pattern. The concrete type is currently needed because setValueColumn(string $column) resolves columns via $this->grid->columns(). Fix: add columns(): ColumnManager to DataGridInterface (it already has a concrete implementation), then change the constructor parameter to DataGridInterface. This also enables proper unit testing with test doubles.

BaseGridRenderer::createSelectionHeaderCell() (line 380) generates an onclick handler that targets all `input[name="selected[]"]` on the entire page, not scoped to the current grid. On a page with two grids both having actions, the select-all checkbox of each grid would toggle checkboxes in both grids. Fix: scope the querySelectorAll to the enclosing form or table by ID, e.g. `document.querySelectorAll('#grid-{id} input[name="selected[]"]')` or `this.closest('form').querySelectorAll(...)`.

GridActions::processSubmittedActions() passes the raw $postData['selected'] slice directly to the action callback without normalizing values to strings. Depending on how the POST payload is constructed (or mocked in tests), array elements could be non-string scalars. Adding array_map('strval', $selectedValues) before the callback invocation would make the type contract explicit and consistent with how a string value column is expected to be used.
